statements.quote: For the additional 70MW expansion, Core Scientific is responsible for funding $104 million of capex ($1.5M per MW) for the powered core and shell with no capex credit associated with this new agreement.
statements.notes: Capex commitment for the 70 MW HPC hosting expansion at Denton, TX for CoreWeave. The sentence says HPC, not AI. p01 ties the HPC hosting conversions to artificial intelligence-related workloads. No year is named; the infrastructure delivery timeline in p03 spans 2025–2026. The separate ~$750 million build-out in the same passage is funded by CoreWeave and credited against hosting payments. It is not the company's own AI capex, so it is not recorded.
